input_fields.name: target_viewport
input_fields.description: One visible target viewport in the maximized SpaceClaim session.

input_fields.name: model_identity
input_fields.description: Current model/document identity and hash or explicit unsaved identity.

input_fields.name: view_state
input_fields.description: Observed camera/orientation and selection state at capture time.

input_fields.name: expected_and_observed
input_fields.description: One expected visual claim and the observed result to bind to the screenshot metadata.

result_fields.name: screenshot_artifact
result_fields.description: One screenshot path/hash and metadata binding model, view, selection, expectation, and observation.

procedure: Confirm target_viewport, model_identity, view_state, and expected_and_observed before capture.

Require the layout to be already maximized and the selection state appropriate for the claim. If preparation is missing, return it to the separate layout/selection action; do not perform those actions inside screenshot capture.
Capture exactly one screenshot and record path/hash, model identity, view, selection, expectation, and observation.
Return screenshot_artifact; if pixels or metadata cannot be bound to the actual session, report needs_manual_review.
rejection_rules: Reject an ambiguous model/view, obstructed viewport, unauthorized destination, mismatched model hash, or an untraceable screenshot.
Do not claim visual agreement from file existence alone.
Do not overwrite an unrelated evidence artifact.
